h: Kylian Mbappe reportedly scores twice in El Clasico, shaking up Ballon d'Or talk
p: Kylian Mbappe has reportedly scored two goals in El Clasico, prompting fresh updates to the Ballon d'Or rankings. Fans and pundits are debating where the goals leave him in this year's race. Ballon d'Or rankings have since been updated to reflect his form.
more: Ballon d'Or rankings have reportedly been reshuffled after the match.
Fans are debating his place in this year's race.
